item.description: President Trump said that the U.S. launched “large and powerful” strikes on Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz. NBC News' Keir Simmons reports.

item.description: Deliberations in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial were briefly paused this morning after the jury announced they were unable to come to a unanimous decision. NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris explains how and when the judge would potentially decide to move forward with a hung jury.
